complete_original.full_chain_observation: Registries.preInit registers the actual boss, turret and projectile; proxy.preInit binds actual boss renderer; SoundRegistry class is registered on Forge event bus. Each boss initializes all twenty face bits active and a separate 1x1 inner core AABB. EntityDamageSource selects immediate entity before true source, forms a 64-scaled look/motion ray, rotates it into shield coordinates, tests active faces and selects by face-centroid distance. A face refusal returns false from boss damage. A hole only permits calling super.attackEntityFrom if the same ray also intersects the inner core; parent result is preserved. For refused entity damage, a boss-local Entity-object map independently budgets true source and immediate source. An absent entry receives velocity overwrite, a MAGIC 2 attempt and map value 10 regardless of damage result. Same source object is admitted once because first insertion suppresses second. NOPE sound is emitted when at least one map entry was newly admitted; it is not a successful-damage receipt. Countdown removes an entry on a later update after it reaches zero. Normal boss turret production chooses deflectable state. Turret update creates a projectile with boss owner and transfers the deflectable flag. Sword-player damage on a deflectable projectile attempts startRiding if player has no passengers, broadcasts passengers and returns true without checking mounting success. While riding, a non-swing observation arms release; later swing shoots, dismounts and changes only thrower to player. Original owner remains boss. Collision excludes thrower, allowing the returned projectile to reach boss. Projectile boss impact raycasts active faces; server clears one face bit and emits SHIELD_DOWN, spawns eighteen supporting projectiles, and sets boss floating=false. If no face is hit it calls GENERIC 10, which this boss rejects because it is neither EntityDamageSource nor out-of-world; return is ignored and server still drops floating state. No claim of ten actual HP damage. Boss server publishes packed face bits during alive update only when player list in grown 32x16x32 AABB is nonempty; client reads packed state each update. Actual registered renderer skips inactive faces and consumes local per-face animation ticks. attackShield client branch can set animation=20, but no dedicated server-to-client hit-receipt packet is shown, so authoritative hit flash delivery is NOT claimed. Random client ambience uses 40->21 then resets at20, distinct from local hit animation. NBT saves packed faces and deathTicks; reading only accepts INT shields, preserving constructor state if absent. Recoil map and per-face animation are transient. Death update clears faces by deathTicks and publishes packed data; XP/loot are not counted as another researched mechanism. Blockade boss-owned branch can heal health after player damage; shield repair belongs to its separate player-capability branch and is not attributed to this boss.

whole_mechanism_comparisons.concrete_observation: 计1：以首次攻击尝试打开后续拒绝窗口，不同Vizier实际parent hurt成功后30tick窗口。首次攻击之后若被别的护盾/owner政策拒绝仍已开窗口，不能称首次成功受伤才触发；窗口不延长每次重复攻击。cancel后本方法攻击宠物的CHAIN_LIGHTNING/FROST_FANG/BUBBLING/VAMPIRE/WARPING_BITE分支仍可走，只有最终healer impulse检查!event.isCanceled。IMMUNITY_FRAME与BLAZING_PROTECTION正常附魔互斥，不能拿双装备构造当原生可得。无灰字/按目标回执去重。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.limitations: 实际关键完整方法已读，非整篇CommonProxy/TameableUtils。Citadel sync仅确认本类调用all/server PropertiesMessage，外部收包实现未读，不能声称网络身份验证或像素通过。CollarTickTracker及调用静态已读，仅支持0；不复用守卫旧账、不改生产内容。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation: 原生corpse.hurt→bypass删除 或 nearestPlayer→trigger(flag/sound)→原生tick计时→server新Boss实体/FX→discard
whole_mechanism_comparisons.concrete_observation: DeadKingCorpse.hurt对bypass来源discard且true，其他来源无论amount都找8格最近玩家，有玩家trigger后返回false。trigger仅TRIGGERED尚false时播复活声并同步true；server tick触发动画时长>300后生成新DeadKingBoss、spawn声/粒子并discard尸体，每tick还回满HP。 主岗：拒伤主动幂等触发复活计时并替换为新Boss实体，区别Frostmaw原实体苏醒；整条阶段转移/反馈只计1，不据hurt=false宣称无后果，不据bypass true宣称扣血。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.application_to_boss_immune: 返回false不一定是没有 gameplay 后果：拒伤可以只推进Boss阶段。免疫字若显示也不能吞掉阶段触发；音效幂等依赖同步触发位，不靠HP变更。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.limitations: 最近玩家未必攻击者，环境伤害也可能唤醒；hurt未显式server-only，trigger声/位可两侧调用，实体生成只server；绕过伤害返回true仅代表删除，不是扣血成功。 主岗全文复核固定版本；静态不证明实际观感/音量/TCP/Boss覆盖；普通体质不要求灰字；守卫旧账0转入。

complete_original.full_chain_observation: Registries.preInit registers the actual boss, turret and projectile; proxy.preInit binds actual boss renderer; SoundRegistry class is registered on Forge event bus. Each boss initializes all twenty face bits active and a separate 1x1 inner core AABB. EntityDamageSource selects immediate entity before true source, forms a 64-scaled look/motion ray, rotates it into shield coordinates, tests active faces and selects by face-centroid distance. A face refusal returns false from boss damage. A hole only permits calling super.attackEntityFrom if the same ray also intersects the inner core; parent result is preserved. For refused entity damage, a boss-local Entity-object map independently budgets true source and immediate source. An absent entry receives velocity overwrite, a MAGIC 2 attempt and map value 10 regardless of damage result. Same source object is admitted once because first insertion suppresses second. NOPE sound is emitted when at least one map entry was newly admitted; it is not a successful-damage receipt. Countdown removes an entry on a later update after it reaches zero. Normal boss turret production chooses deflectable state. Turret update creates a projectile with boss owner and transfers the deflectable flag. Sword-player damage on a deflectable projectile attempts startRiding if player has no passengers, broadcasts passengers and returns true without checking mounting success. While riding, a non-swing observation arms release; later swing shoots, dismounts and changes only thrower to player. Original owner remains boss. Collision excludes thrower, allowing the returned projectile to reach boss. Projectile boss impact raycasts active faces; server clears one face bit and emits SHIELD_DOWN, spawns eighteen supporting projectiles, and sets boss floating=false. If no face is hit it calls GENERIC 10, which this boss rejects because it is neither EntityDamageSource nor out-of-world; return is ignored and server still drops floating state. No claim of ten actual HP damage. Boss server publishes packed face bits during alive update only when player list in grown 32x16x32 AABB is nonempty; client reads packed state each update. Actual registered renderer skips inactive faces and consumes local per-face animation ticks. attackShield client branch can set animation=20, but no dedicated server-to-client hit-receipt packet is shown, so authoritative hit flash delivery is NOT claimed. Random client ambience uses 40->21 then resets at20, distinct from local hit animation. NBT saves packed faces and deathTicks; reading only accepts INT shields, preserving constructor state if absent. Recoil map and per-face animation are transient. Death update clears faces by deathTicks and publishes packed data; XP/loot are not counted as another researched mechanism. Blockade boss-owned branch can heal health after player damage; shield repair belongs to its separate player-capability branch and is not attributed to this boss.
complete_original.concrete_observation: Root boss active20face mesh rayrefusal then innercore AABB parentresult; actual sword-riding return changes thrower only and removesface notnecessarilyHP. Registeredworldentity/clientrenderer/sound binding read. True/immediate sourceobject recoil budget counts attempted responses not damage ACK.

complete_original.limitations: Geometry is not proven correct: rayTraceTriangle only tests 1-t>epsilon, not t>=0; candidate chooses closest face centroid, not intersection parameter. RotationMatrix returns early for initial zero angles with its default zero matrix. These are static observations, not executed repros. Projectile shield trace supplies getShieldRotationYaw for roll, unlike ordinary boss attack and renderer using roll. Do not claim precise hit/render agreement. Creative non-sneaking entity bypasses shield but still needs core; sneaking branch may cast a non-player attacker to EntityPlayer without a preceding type test. No claim that native mobs naturally trigger that edge. Recoil normalization has no zero-length guard; true/immediate damage calls ignore their result. Map is per boss/live Entity object, not UUID/epoch/cast ID. Reload loses budget. Source-less attacks are rejected except matching outOfWorld damage type; there is no generic rejection cue for every false result. Projectile owner resolution searches local entities within64; missing/unloaded owner is not same as confirmed dead owner. Lifetime ticks increment only while not riding; setDead at >200 does not immediately return. Mount attempt result and world.spawnEntity results are ignored. Death cleanup list is queried as EntityWight.class before later instanceof tests for turrets/projectiles/blockades; those later types are not established members of that queried list. Do not claim complete owned-add cleanup or crash-atomic XP settlement. complete_original.full_chain_observation: Registries.preInit registers the actual boss, turret and projectile; proxy.preInit binds actual boss renderer; SoundRegistry class is registered on Forge event bus. Each boss initializes all twenty face bits active and a separate 1x1 inner core AABB. EntityDamageSource selects immediate entity before true source, forms a 64-scaled look/motion ray, rotates it into shield coordinates, tests active faces and selects by face-centroid distance. A face refusal returns false from boss damage. A hole only permits calling super.attackEntityFrom if the same ray also intersects the inner core; parent result is preserved. For refused entity damage, a boss-local Entity-object map independently budgets true source and immediate source. An absent entry receives velocity overwrite, a MAGIC 2 attempt and map value 10 regardless of damage result. Same source object is admitted once because first insertion suppresses second. NOPE sound is emitted when at least one map entry was newly admitted; it is not a successful-damage receipt. Countdown removes an entry on a later update after it reaches zero. Normal boss turret production chooses deflectable state. Turret update creates a projectile with boss owner and transfers the deflectable flag. Sword-player damage on a deflectable projectile attempts startRiding if player has no passengers, broadcasts passengers and returns true without checking mounting success. While riding, a non-swing observation arms release; later swing shoots, dismounts and changes only thrower to player. Original owner remains boss. Collision excludes thrower, allowing the returned projectile to reach boss. Projectile boss impact raycasts active faces; server clears one face bit and emits SHIELD_DOWN, spawns eighteen supporting projectiles, and sets boss floating=false. If no face is hit it calls GENERIC 10, which this boss rejects because it is neither EntityDamageSource nor out-of-world; return is ignored and server still drops floating state. No claim of ten actual HP damage. Boss server publishes packed face bits during alive update only when player list in grown 32x16x32 AABB is nonempty; client reads packed state each update. Actual registered renderer skips inactive faces and consumes local per-face animation ticks. attackShield client branch can set animation=20, but no dedicated server-to-client hit-receipt packet is shown, so authoritative hit flash delivery is NOT claimed. Random client ambience uses 40->21 then resets at20, distinct from local hit animation. NBT saves packed faces and deathTicks; reading only accepts INT shields, preserving constructor state if absent. Recoil map and per-face animation are transient. Death update clears faces by deathTicks and publishes packed data; XP/loot are not counted as another researched mechanism. Blockade boss-owned branch can heal health after player damage; shield repair belongs to its separate player-capability branch and is not attributed to this boss.

whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation: 原生corpse.hurt→bypass删除 或 nearestPlayer→trigger(flag/sound)→原生tick计时→server新Boss实体/FX→discard
whole_mechanism_comparisons.concrete_observation: DeadKingCorpse.hurt对bypass来源discard且true，其他来源无论amount都找8格最近玩家，有玩家trigger后返回false。trigger仅TRIGGERED尚false时播复活声并同步true；server tick触发动画时长>300后生成新DeadKingBoss、spawn声/粒子并discard尸体，每tick还回满HP。 主岗：拒伤主动幂等触发复活计时并替换为新Boss实体，区别Frostmaw原实体苏醒；整条阶段转移/反馈只计1，不据hurt=false宣称无后果，不据bypass true宣称扣血。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.application_to_boss_immune: 返回false不一定是没有 gameplay 后果：拒伤可以只推进Boss阶段。免疫字若显示也不能吞掉阶段触发；音效幂等依赖同步触发位，不靠HP变更。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.limitations: 最近玩家未必攻击者，环境伤害也可能唤醒；hurt未显式server-only，trigger声/位可两侧调用，实体生成只server；绕过伤害返回true仅代表删除，不是扣血成功。 主岗全文复核固定版本；静态不证明实际观感/音量/TCP/Boss覆盖；普通体质不要求灰字；守卫旧账0转入。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation: 命中ShieldPart→parent.takeDamage→health/impact→ShieldEntity.tick重置
whole_mechanism_comparisons.concrete_observation: ShieldPart.hurt仅服务端且父hurtThisTick未置时转父takeDamage，然后置标记，始终return false；takeDamage非invulnerable时扣父HP，命中点火花/冲击声；Shield.tick每tick重置去重。 主岗复核：只计共享父盾hurtThisTick对所有子盾同tick命中的合并消费策略；盾资源损失和hurt=false仍区分，非重复计通用盾吸收。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.application_to_boss_immune: 同目标多部件合并应归父实体；false可能已实际扣护盾HP，不能作为Immune。
whole_mechanism_comparisons.limitations: hurtThisTick不区分攻击者和攻击次数，可能合并同tick不同攻击；拒绝时也置标记；无文字消息。 静态源码研究，不证明画面/声音或TCP。普通阴阳体质不要求灰字；守卫旧账0自动转入。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation: 真实mod preInit→Registries→EntityRegistry.pyrad注册到EntityPyrad；ACTIVE/CHARGING初始false，activeTasks先构造列表，setActive服务端添加/移除实际任务。直接父EntityFlyingMob没有attackEntityFrom覆写，父伤害进入原生EntityMob边界。 活着且!ACTIVE时先看hitTicks<=0：只有server且(random12==0 OR amount>3)才setActive(true)然后return super.attackEntityFrom。否则循环10次PYRAD_HURT调用，client分支各发WEEDWOOD_LEAF请求，设置hitTicks20，返回false。hitTicks>0时直接false，既不抽签、不看强伤、不重置计时、不重放此反馈。 onLivingUpdate每次若hitTicks>0减1；环境wake独立且先于该递减：server alive且aggressive属性1/低亮度/在水且inactive时active=true。紧接独立if在aggressive0、alive、active、无target、random800==0时active=false，可同一次更新撤掉环境唤醒。 ACTIVE持久化到active NBT并通过DataManager定义同步；读取NBT调用setActive恢复任务资格。hitTicks普通字段，在自身写/读方法没有保存或同步；setActive本身也不清hitTicks。ACTIVE时忽略该计时直接parent伤害，若又休眠且timer尚正则再次受该门约束。 休眠knockBack不调用父，canBePushed要求active；travel仍含重力/父移动，不能宣称所有控制免疫。activeTicks独立决定缩小身体/碰撞形态，不是伤害准入条件。全链声音只验证生产调用、标识及注册，未追原版Entity.playSound传输或音频，未读模型/贴图。

Environment may wake independently; active state then bypasses timer to parent damage. Serialized ACTIVE distinct from transient timer. No final HP or control success guarantee.

whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation: 原生注册MysteriousPot并自身registerGoals装HideAgainGoal；hurtServer非bypass且未active且amount>0时按directsource方位取整90度转向、jump、active同步true、hideCooldown200并false。active或bypass走原生superhurt；weapon BREAKS_DECORATED_POTS可使amount翻倍。tick减cooldown；HideAgainGoal须cooldown<=0&&active&&navigationdone，16范围combat玩家为空或所有玩家无LOS才start snap到blockPos且active=false重新装填。ACTIVE同步更新refreshDimensions，未active时immobile和可碰撞。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.application_to_boss_immune: 拒绝理由应在实际接纳门生成；触发姿态动作仍可能此次无伤，冷却到期不等于可再触发，还要实测状态资格。Boss字不应靠hurt=false猜测。

whole_mechanism_comparisons.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控本身与反弹推人要区分；库存/冷却不是回执去重。应在一次权威拒绝后按目标限频发灰字/有限微光/既有声音，而不是每个辅助setter都生成提示。

author_observations: Actual static @Mod.EventBusSubscriber native Forge handlers: HIGHEST Applicable checks affected entity instanceofPlayer, gathers EffectImmunityBonus and first passing predicate setsDENY thenreturns; no side guard or cue in this method.

Immunity predicate tests effect then current affected-player condition; no amplifier/duration/input DamageSource passed. None predicate default returns true; ID predicate compares effect object identity. Configurable predicates are not automatically harmful-only.

LOWEST receiveCanceled=true Applicable bypass handler reads affectedEntity.getKillCredit; requires that returned object instanceofPlayer. It never reads the addEffect source argument, original DamageSource or effect creator. Applicable itself is HasResult and noncancellable, so receiveCanceled is not a demonstrated cancellation override.

Bypass gathers EffectImmunityBypassBonus from remembered player, checks effect then target enemyCondition then playerCondition, first match requestsALLOW and returns. It does not require an earlier DENY; it can replace DEFAULT or DENY under otherwise normal dispatch.
Predicate method accepts nullable Player and null short-circuits playerCondition, but this actual handler only invokes it after nonnull instanceofPlayer; no null-source bypass route claimed.

In native1.20.1-47.4.10 base canBeAffected postsApplicable, consumes nonDEFAULT ALLOW/DENY before built-in undead poison/regeneration fallback. Thus surviving ALLOW at this base consumer can bypass that fallback, conditional on reaching base and no later listener override/exception.

Native getKillCredit returns nonnull lastHurtByPlayer first, else lastHurtByMob. It does not freshly inspect incoming effect source and does not validate player alive/world/identity against current effect at this getter.

Native hurt source entity Player records player/time100; tame animal can record player owner. Existing old hurt source support0 reused. Setter setLastHurtByPlayer instead assigns tickCount to remaining field; exact100 only applies shown hurt path, not universal lease.

Complete native baseTick decrements positive lastHurtByPlayerTime and only clears player in else, with independent lastHurtByMob dead/>100timestamp cleanup. Getter itself ignores time; no exact100walltick/real-time or every-subclass guarantee.

Conditional stale-credit example from actual old888 handler: nonplayer native attack bridge postsLivingAttackEvent before shown hurt credit update; PoisonedWeaponEvents requests addEffect(instance,currentplayer) inside event. Applicable bypass can consequently consult prior player credit rather than currentplayer. No live multi-player fault reproduction asserted.

SkillBonusProvider returns empty unless capability isPresent; this means attached capability availability, not at least one learned skill. It concatenates learned-skill, current SkillBonusEffect and eligible equipment bonuses; no getMerged call in either handler.

Effect contribution copy/multiply uses raw amplifier; shown immunity/bypass multiply methods were outside selected core claim, so no positivelevel or scaling conclusion drawn. Provider materializes list at lookup, no transaction or stable ordering promise.

PlayerHelper includes vanilla slots plusCurios ifloaded; main hand excludes nonweapon/tool/potion, offhand excludespotion. Optional Curios internals and arbitrary item/group/predicate pipelines remain old-owned or unexpanded.

Native addEffect first canBeAffected, then Added and insert/update. Admissiontrue is not necessarily changed active instance: existing updatefalse returnsfalse; old MobEffectInstance hidden/update boundaries preserved. ALLOW is not final control/HP/success receipt.
Existing136 Wither canBeAffected for WITHER returnsfalse directly before super, so this baseApplicable policy is not universal Boss immunity bypass. No newWither credit, no target class patched.
Registry declarations have distinct effect_immunity and ignore_effect_immunity serializers; declarations are not actual learned/equipped/granted payload, payment/acquisition or pack integration.

One proposed whole only: two priority-separated applicability writers with different authority sources (affected-player versus remembered-credit-player) and conditional base consumer, not two event handlers/newmodname/constant wrappers.

No explicit IMMUNE reason, grey text, sound, packet or per-target presentation lease is generated by these two methods. The research advises correct target/source provenance and final arbitration without adding ordinary-body greyword rules.

actual_finding_responses.Main_finding: DENY eligibility reads the affected Player and requested effect predicate; no source/amplifier/duration input here. NoneLivingEntityPredicate accepts all, MobEffectIdPredicate compares effect object identity. No harmful-only default inferred.

It ignores the current addEffect source, current DamageSource and original effect creator; old credited player is not the effect source. Applicable contains only target+effect, not the separate Added source.
actual_finding_responses.author_response: 确认bypass从affectedEntity.getKillCredit读记忆并要求Player；不是本次addEffect来源、当前DamageSource或effectcreator。Applicable仅target/effect，没有Added另带source；不能以effectSource变量名冒充实际来源。

actual_finding_responses.Main_finding: LOWEST matching bonus requests ALLOW without checking current Result, so normal dispatch can replace DEFAULT or earlier DENY. receiveCanceled=true does not establish cancellation override: this Applicable is HasResult, expressly noncancelable.
actual_finding_responses.author_response: 确认LOWEST匹配直接写ALLOW，没有先核旧Result，因此正常dispatch可改DEFAULT或DENY。Applicable是HasResult且不可取消，receiveCanceled=true不证明取消被覆盖，也不证明后来listener不能再改结果。

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation: Fabric入口→Bumblezone.init具体注册CalmingEssence.OnAttack到EVENT_LOWEST、Items/DataComponents和两mixin json实际包含Player/LivingEntity hook。具体essence_calming factory、ability essence item tag、默认activity组件与其codec已核。native inventoryTick仅ServerPlayer且已essenced、无cooldown、同一offhand stack启用；Player.canBeSeenAsEnemy返回值在active时改false。实际apply每20错峰entitytick扫描60格清Mob对持有者target/中立anger/Warden anger，tag例外；每12tick持有者sparkle。实际hurt Fabric injection在actuallyHurt即将getDamageAfterArmorAbsorb前invoke→OnAttack对Player攻Mob或Mob攻Player将使用量0并setDepleted，形成战斗撤销防敌对状态链。
complete_original_object.concrete_observation: 一条可撤销的持物安抚/周期清目标/战斗破坏资格与资源恢复生命周期1，与Botania永久修改goal并标记重载重建、Diva延迟转移hurt目标、旧GuardianHeart临时随机友方setTarget不同；不按Mob/Neutral/Warden、20tick/12tick、item bar/tooltip/codec另计。攻击事件位置是护甲前，忽略amount/最终HP，不能叫最终伤害成功回执；撤销与FX无明确拒控收据。neutral anger UUID用==对象身份而非equals，不推全仇恨清除。allow_anger_through固定默认空表，扩展后仅跳扫描，Player可见敌人hook没查该tag。
complete_original_object.application_to_boss_immune: Boss免控灰字应来自权威拒控分支，不能用中途hurt或安抚sparkle推已成功取消。资格被战斗/脱手/冷却撤销时，过时提示不能继续锚定；对生命期/反馈节流需区分实体tick周期与每目标拒控冷却。普通阴阳不用新增灰字，不引入新安抚机制。
complete_original_object.limitations: 已全文所列Calming/Ability/Essence/player/fabric事件与入口方法；外部Resourceful/Fabric/原版canBeSeenAsEnemy消费者、组件库存网络与vanilla伤害内部未展开，不声称所有AI受影响、跨端图标或声音像素通过。hasEssence capability数据接入只读到PlatformService接口使用，持久化provider不宣称闭合。Ability父inventoryTick先存旧active/cooldown局部，再调apply；子apply耗尽写新组件后父按旧快照的isDifferent条件可能复写forcedCooldown，且新装备active写入在apply之后，本tick子方法仍读旧值；只记静态分支，不称已实机复现失效。创意/旁观在decrement免耗，但OnAttack直接deplete无豁免。sparkle服务器位置广播未查实际粒子factory，观感未验；item tooltip/条不是世界Boss文字。

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation:
One complete autonomous area-control policy, not an entity-versus-block variant: registered Horologium mantle reacts to qualified native player hurt, creates a fixed-center zone excluding current player numeric ID, commits shared mantle cooldown, then attempts400 charge drain. Gate includes actual chest mantle/weak registered constellation/enabled effect, server/nonfire/no cooldown/affordability. Original hurt is not canceled. No intervening shown charge mutation supports a free-zone claim; ignored drain result is only a transaction boundary. Defaults range20/life180/cooldown1000 are not installed configuration.
TimeStopController appends newly created zone into dimension list and separately requests provider ADD; return zone/non-null is not an accepted-target receipt. Zone lifetime decrements at SERVER START, then scans until expired; controller checks before and after tick, so last positive lifetime pass can capture and release within the same call. Producer removal or mantle swap does not revoke the autonomous zone.
TimeStopZone scans bounding chunks with world.getChunk, not a demonstrated loaded-only query. In-sphere tiles must be ITickable, permitted by blacklist and currently in world.tickableTileEntities. It removes the actual object before safeCacheTile. Cache deduplicates by BlockPos only. A same-position replacement can be removed without another cache record; overlapping zones observe the already-removed tick participant. No source-owned reference-counted lease.
On stop, retained object is reinserted only when current block reports a tile and constructing a fresh current-block tile yields a class assignable from the cached class. It reinserts the old cached object, not that new factory object or verified current tile. No current-instance identity, removal flag, generation, active overlapping owner or existing list-membership check. Cache is cleared and zone deactivated. Compatible replacement or overlapping lifetime issues are conditional static ownership boundaries, not reproduced duplication/permanent freeze.
Eligibility blacklist includes exact/subclass errored classes and configured type/prefix decisions. Defaults exclude storage and several Astral tiles. ConfigDataAdapter before build exposes empty generated data; postbuild class resolution/cached lists depend on external config lifecycle. Acceleration exception path can blacklist class for future scans; no retroactive release of already cached tiles is shown. No claim about actual installed target eligibility.

Full concrete class actually read, but parent ritual activation remains outside this new entry proof,0 extra producer credit. Normal acceleration uses bounded4..5 manual updates and exception blacklist; mode/constants/helpers0 extra.

Area containment differs from direct freeze-ID membership, skips current excluded ID/dead/dying dragon/player-policy cases, uses current position geometry. LivingDestroyBlock direct-membership path does not become area tile-control evidence. This is native update participation control, not total motion stop, damage immunity or a Boss refusal implementation.
DataTimeFreezeEffects stores per-dimension helper list plus queued ADD/REMOVE; helper equality uses center/range but omits controller/owner/TTL/nonce. Equal geometry removal can remove a different helper. Per-world clear removes server display state without dirty/queued-clear operation, while server/client cleanup paths differ. Visual helper queries current nearby living/tile objects, not actual server tick cache. World unload clears sync world state and asks controller to stop/release cached zones, then removes map; no explicit CLEAR display action. No source-owned durable zone/cache NBT: helper NBT is transport only, not a tested save/restore transaction.

author_observations: Actual static @Mod.EventBusSubscriber native Forge handlers: HIGHEST Applicable checks affected entity instanceofPlayer, gathers EffectImmunityBonus and first passing predicate setsDENY thenreturns; no side guard or cue in this method.

Immunity predicate tests effect then current affected-player condition; no amplifier/duration/input DamageSource passed. None predicate default returns true; ID predicate compares effect object identity. Configurable predicates are not automatically harmful-only.

LOWEST receiveCanceled=true Applicable bypass handler reads affectedEntity.getKillCredit; requires that returned object instanceofPlayer. It never reads the addEffect source argument, original DamageSource or effect creator. Applicable itself is HasResult and noncancellable, so receiveCanceled is not a demonstrated cancellation override.

Bypass gathers EffectImmunityBypassBonus from remembered player, checks effect then target enemyCondition then playerCondition, first match requestsALLOW and returns. It does not require an earlier DENY; it can replace DEFAULT or DENY under otherwise normal dispatch.

Native getKillCredit returns nonnull lastHurtByPlayer first, else lastHurtByMob. It does not freshly inspect incoming effect source and does not validate player alive/world/identity against current effect at this getter.

Native hurt source entity Player records player/time100; tame animal can record player owner. Existing old hurt source support0 reused. Setter setLastHurtByPlayer instead assigns tickCount to remaining field; exact100 only applies shown hurt path, not universal lease.

Complete native baseTick decrements positive lastHurtByPlayerTime and only clears player in else, with independent lastHurtByMob dead/>100timestamp cleanup. Getter itself ignores time; no exact100walltick/real-time or every-subclass guarantee.

Conditional stale-credit example from actual old888 handler: nonplayer native attack bridge postsLivingAttackEvent before shown hurt credit update; PoisonedWeaponEvents requests addEffect(instance,currentplayer) inside event. Applicable bypass can consequently consult prior player credit rather than currentplayer. No live multi-player fault reproduction asserted.

SkillBonusProvider returns empty unless capability isPresent; this means attached capability availability, not at least one learned skill. It concatenates learned-skill, current SkillBonusEffect and eligible equipment bonuses; no getMerged call in either handler.

Effect contribution copy/multiply uses raw amplifier; shown immunity/bypass multiply methods were outside selected core claim, so no positivelevel or scaling conclusion drawn. Provider materializes list at lookup, no transaction or stable ordering promise.

PlayerHelper includes vanilla slots plusCurios ifloaded; main hand excludes nonweapon/tool/potion, offhand excludespotion. Optional Curios internals and arbitrary item/group/predicate pipelines remain old-owned or unexpanded.

Native addEffect first canBeAffected, then Added and insert/update. Admissiontrue is not necessarily changed active instance: existing updatefalse returnsfalse; old MobEffectInstance hidden/update boundaries preserved. ALLOW is not final control/HP/success receipt.
Existing136 Wither canBeAffected for WITHER returnsfalse directly before super, so this baseApplicable policy is not universal Boss immunity bypass. No newWither credit, no target class patched.
Registry declarations have distinct effect_immunity and ignore_effect_immunity serializers; declarations are not actual learned/equipped/granted payload, payment/acquisition or pack integration.
